Some breeds are prone to going broody, where they stop laying eggs and try to sit on them and hatch them so do your reaserch. Matching them to your climate is very important also dont let them be around rotten straw, theyre verry badly affected by some fungus that grows in wet straw. Make sure to spray for mites every month or so.
